product.notFor: Not for people who want a ghostwriter to do the work.
product.govFor: Companies of about 5–50 people that already use ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar — and sell to the EU/UK or to a larger buyer that sends vendor questionnaires. You are mostly a user of someone else’s model.
product.govNotFor: Not for hospitals, banks, or governments deploying high-risk AI as a core system. Not for anyone who wants a stamp that says ‘EU AI Act certified’. Not for resellers.
product.govScience: Uncertain buyers copy what they can inspect. A dated register, a signed paste rule, and a training log are inspectable. A prompt collection is not. Implementation intentions beat goals without a sequence — that is why START-HERE is ordered, and why the survey does not delay the register.
product.govP1l: to a pack you can use internally
product.govP4l: Templates you fill. Counsel still for high-risk.
product.photoFor: Working wedding, portrait, or commercial photographers who already shoot paying jobs and leak them in DMs, unpaid revisions, or galleries that open before the balance is paid.
product.photoNotFor: Not for someone who has never had a paying client. Not a lighting course. Not a lawyer-drafted contract. Not for resale as an Etsy dump.
product.photoScience: Saturdays are finite inventory. Implementation intentions beat mood. A retainer gate, a revision cap, and a 15-minute formals block are inspectable rules — a pretty CRM is not.
product.photoP1l: to a desk you can run this week
product.photoP2l: reply, prices, retainer, formals, cap, gallery, invoices, Monday
product.photoP4l: Sheets + Notion + calculator. Counsel still for contracts.
product.keysFor: Mobile locksmiths, shop techs expanding into remotes, and serious apprentices building a legal Add-Key practice. You already respect the bay. You want a sequence: verify → quote → prepare → program → test → refer.
product.keysNotFor: Not for anyone who wants theft, skipped paperwork, stolen-vehicle starts, undocumented immobilizer bypass, EEPROM attacks, or a dealer-login dump. Not a certificate. Not legal advice. Not a ‘works on every car’ kit.
product.keysEthics: Program or cut keys only for the verified owner or documented authorized agent of that specific vehicle. Photo ID + registration/title. Log the job. If the story is wrong, the job is over.
product.keysScience: Competence is a repeated honest sequence, not a hack. Ownership paperwork before OBD write. Power support before immobilizer data. Referral when the platform is outside your kit. That is why START-HERE and Chapters 1–2 are not optional.
product.keysP2l: ID + registration before any OBD write
product.keysP3l: one technician · not a $9 PDF dump
product.crmFor: Freelancers, small studios, and solo operators who leak follow-ups across Notes, chat, and a folder of invoices. You want one desk that opens tonight.
product.crmNotFor: Not a SaaS subscription. Not accounting software. Not legal or tax advice. Not for resale as a marketplace dump.
product.crmScience: One local store. Charts that update when you add a row. CSV when the accountant asks. Implementation beats another pretty Google Sheet you never open.
product.crmP1l: Setup → Database → Log → Tasks → Calendar → Overview → Dashboard
product.crmP4l: export this window or the whole desk

about.title: The house
about.body: Digi World exists because the internet taught ambitious people to collect files. We design products instead — sequenced, certified, named.
about.why: A file has no identity. A product has a serial, a drop, and a studio. That’s how you charge for seriousness without lying about page count.
about.drop: The first house release. Creator, AI, wealth, glow. Limited license pool per drop.
about.cert: Our mark. Not a fake ISO. It means sequenced, start-here, bilingual where it matters, licensed.

legal.privacy: We collect name, email, IP, and ad click IDs to deliver your vault and measure ads (Meta, TikTok, Snap — browser pixel + CAPI). We store orders in our database and a private operations sheet. We do not sell your list.
legal.terms: Personal digital license. No redistribution. Worldwide. Prices in USD. Digi World · digi-world.online.
legal.refunds: 7-day vault guarantee if files are corrupted, the wrong SKU, or won’t open. Not a ‘I didn’t use it’ refund. Contact hello@digi-world.online with your order ID.
legal.cookies: Essential cookies run the vault. Marketing pixels (Meta, TikTok, Snap) load after you accept, or you can refuse. Click IDs may still be stored first-party so a later purchase can be attributed.
